notes.title: Gun Store Simulator – Participates in Steam Next Fest Starting February 24!
notes.notes:
Dear Future Gun Store Owners,

We are excited to announce that Gun Store Simulator is part of Steam Next Fest, starting February 24! Gun Store Simulator is your chance to become a gun store owner! From February 24 to March 1, take part in Steam Next Fest and try out both the demo version and the full version of the game!

In this game, you will manage a store, select products, hire staff, and ensure security. Your decisions will determine the fate of the business! Feel like a true gun market tycoon!

Try the demo version, build your store, interact with customers, and evaluate the main mechanics of the game. Don’t miss the unique opportunity to test the game and leave your mark on its development.

Add Gun Store Simulator to your WISHLIST to stay updated on the most important updates! Become a part of our community, participate in the game’s development, and help create the best gun business simulator.

Don’t miss your chance! Join us at Steam Next Fest and become a legend of the gun market!

See you at the festival! The Gun Store Simulator Team

notes.title: Experience Gun Store Simulator First – Free Demo on February 20!
notes.notes:
Dear Future Gun Store Owners,

The wait is almost over! On February 20, the Gun Store Simulator demo goes live, giving you the first taste of managing your very own firearms business. From stocking shelves to handling licenses, every decision is in your hands!

What Awaits You in the Demo?
• Stock & Sell – Choose the right products, analyze demand, and attract customers.
• Hire & Manage Staff – Build an expert team to keep operations running smoothly.
• Ensure Safety & Compliance – Get proper licenses, follow regulations, and maintain order.

This demo offers an exclusive glimpse into the challenges and rewards of running a gun store. Your feedback will help shape the final game, so don’t miss out!

Mark your calendar – February 20! Play the demo, share your thoughts, and wishlist Gun Store Simulator to stay updated!

Are you ready to dominate the firearms market? Let’s find out!

See you,
The Gun Store Simulator Team
